# robots.blocks-all — robots.txt blocks every search engine from the whole site

- **Check ID:** `robots.blocks-all`
- **Default severity:** `warning`; users can override it in `seaworthy.config.json`.
- **Needs:** `html`
- **Standards:** none
- **Source module:** `packages/verify/src/checks/sitemap.ts`
- **Prose page:** [`docs/checks/robots.blocks-all.md`](../robots.blocks-all.md) — embedded below verbatim; write it there, never here.

robots.txt tells every crawler not to visit anything.

## Why it matters

`User-agent: *` with `Disallow: /` keeps the whole site out of search results. It is a common leftover from a staging site that was copied to production.

## What it checks

In robots.txt, a group for `User-agent: *` that contains `Disallow: /` and no `Allow` rule is reported. Groups for specific crawlers are not.

## How to fix

Remove `Disallow: /`, unless the site is meant to be private:

```text
User-agent: *
Allow: /
```

## Options

None.

## Standards

- [RFC 9309 Robots Exclusion Protocol](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9309)
